title: PG Certificate Program in Family Business Management
description: Embark on a 12-month learning journey in strategic, governance, financial, and digital capabilities to lead and scale family enterprises.

content.title: who should join
points: Next-Gen Leaders: Build leadership capabilities and prepare to lead the family business into its next chapter
Family Business Leaders: Drive growth, professionalisation, and long-term transformation
Family Entrepreneurs: Identify new opportunities, foster innovation, and scale the enterprise
Family Office Leaders: Strengthen wealth stewardship, governance, and strategic investment decision-making
Professional CXOs: Navigate family-business dynamics while driving strategic and operational excellence
Future CEOs: Develop the strategic, financial, and leadership capabilities to lead the next phase of growth

content.title: program snapshot
points: 4 Pillars: Enterprise Foundation, Business Strategy, Legacy & Succession, and Global Expansion
Learn from Esteemed IIM Visakhapatnam Faculty and Leading Industry Professionals
EMI Available for up to 24 Months
One 2-Day Campus Immersion at IIM Visakhapatnam

curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Participants develop a comprehensive transformation roadmap for their own or a selected family business. The capstone integrates strategy, governance, ownership, innovation, and succession planning to address real organizational challenges. Participants present actionable recommendations to strengthen long-term growth, professionalization, and multi-generational continuity of the family enterprise
